units.text: Note. For the administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.

units.text: 1. Failure by the owner or other holder of a traffic exchange point to fulfil the obligation to notify the authorised federal executive body of the commencement of activities to ensure the functioning of the traffic exchange point, or violation of the prescribed procedure for submitting notices of commencement of those activities, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.43

units.locator: Article 13.43. Violation of legislative requirements for ensuring the functioning of traffic exchange points or legislative requirements for ensuring stable functioning of communications facilities that interact with other communications facilities
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on individual entrepreneurs, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
